description: This file contains unit tests for the PageStatistics class within the book project's statistics module. It uses JUnit 5 for testing and asserts the correctness of methods like finding the book with the most pages and calculating average page lengths.

classes.name: PageStatisticsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PageStatistics, testing functionalities such as identifying the book with most pages and calculating average page length within the context of the book project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup by clearing existing books and populating read books before each test.

methods.name: findBookWithMostPages
methods.description: Tests that the method correctly identifies the book with the most pages.

methods.name: countOnlyReadBooksTowardsMostPagesStatistics
methods.description: Ensures that only books marked as read are considered when determining the book with the most pages.

methods.name: notDivideAveragePageLengthByZero
methods.description: Checks that the calculation of average page length handles division by zero gracefully, returning empty when appropriate.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthCorrectly
methods.description: Verifies accurate calculation of the average page length across multiple books.

methods.name: calculateAveragePageLengthWithFloatPointCalculationCorrectly
methods.description: Tests proper calculation of average page length, including floating point precision.

methods.name: resetPageStatistics
methods.description: Resets the PageStatistics instance and clears books for test reinitialization.
